answer: Admission auction: each agent bids an opal stake for one vertex slot. Slots cap per epoch, so sybils cannot mint identities free; every extra vertex pays the clearing price. Bids lock for 20 epochs, and a cheating slot loses its stake. Honest agents pay once for undiluted rewards, while an attacker building 1,000 vertices at 40 units each spends 40,000 units for at most 30 per identity per epoch. A bridge counts only if both ends hold paid slots.
